issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-16083](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-16083)
### Description

Version: **2.25.2.0-b272**

Dropping any database is currently throwing the below error.**While the database does get dropped**, the error seems unintended and concerning.

```
yugabyte=# create database k;
ERROR:  Given incomplete Transaction


yugabyte=# create database k;
CREATE DATABASE


yugabyte=# drop database k;
server closed the connection unexpectedly
	This probably means the server terminated abnormally
	before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
```

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-16082](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-16082)
### Description

Version: **2.25.2.0-b272**

The first creation attempt for each table seems to be failing with the `ERROR: Invalid table definition: Error creating table dl.users on the master: Given incomplete Transaction`, on retrying, the creation runs into a timeout (mentioned [GH-26700](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/26700))

```
Session 1                                               Session 2
yugabyte=# create database dl;
ERROR:  Given incomplete Transaction
yugabyte=# create database dl;
CREATE DATABASE                          
                                                         dl=# CREATE TABLE users (
                                                              id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
                                                             username TEXT NOT NULL
                                                          );
                                                         ERROR:  Invalid table definition: Error creating table dl.users on the master: Given incomplete Transaction


                                                         dl=# CREATE TABLE users (
                                                             id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
                                                             username TEXT NOT NULL
                                                         );
                                                         ERROR:  Timed out waiting for Create Table
                                                    

```
